summary.text: Pat Snyder is a Republican member of the Wisconsin State Assembly from District 85 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Democrat John Kroll.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as radio talk show host.

paragraphs.text: Patrick Snyder's Ballotpedia profile lists a bachelor's degree from the University of Iowa and a profession of radio talk show host.
He assumed office in the Assembly in 2017.

His 2025-2026 committee assignments are listed as Campaigns and Elections, Children and Families (chair), Education, Health, Mental Health, Veterans and Military Affairs, and Workforce Development (vice-chair).
